reason: B is the stronger proposal because it defines a specific high-entropy diboride composition, processing window, service test, baselines, and falsification criteria, while cited evidence supports single-phase formation and improved hardness/oxidation behavior. Its claimed liquid-phase densification and liquid-metal corrosion mechanism remain unsupported and should be revised, but A is more conventional and relies on doubtful sub-1700 °C SiC-assisted densification and an unspecified silica barrier that may not survive many plating-metal baths.
